## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue, if any.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run backend:test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] New behavior has regression coverage, including relevant failures and boundaries.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or setup changes.

Describe any native runtime checks performed, or why a check does not apply.

## Review notes

Mention changes to project-path constraints, IPC, child processes, credentials,
TeX shell escape, or AI proposal acceptance. Include screenshots for UI changes.
